source_caption:
🎥🎬: X-Men: Days of Future Past (2014)

In a dystopian future, mutant-hunting Sentinels have nearly wiped out both mutants and the humans who help them. With the future on the brink of destruction, the X-Men send Wolverine’s consciousness back to 1973 to prevent the event that started the Sentinel program.

Wolverine must bring the younger Charles Xavier and Magneto together and stop Mystique from assassinating Bolivar Trask, whose death would ultimately lead to humanity developing the Sentinels. But changing the past means confronting the broken relationships and choices that shaped the X-Men.

As the future and past collide, the team fights to change history before the Sentinel apocalypse becomes inevitable. Wolverine’s mission ultimately creates a new future where humans and mutants have a chance to coexist.

source_details.synopsis: X-Men: Days of Future Past is a 2014 superhero film based on the Marvel Comics superhero team the X-Men. It is the seventh installment in the X-Men film series and serves as a sequel to both X-Men: The Last Stand (2006) and X-Men: First Class (2011), as well as a follow-up to The Wolverine (2013). Directed by Bryan Singer and written by Simon Kinberg, the film features an ensemble cast including Hugh Jackman, James McAvoy, Michael Fassbender, Jennifer Lawrence, Halle Berry, Anna Paquin, Elliot Page, Peter Dinklage, Ian McKellen, and Patrick Stewart.
